initialScope: All six scenes captured for four locales and two device families. New HTML/Markdown content and pinned library captured through actual app UI. Bundle with the next small release.
sourcePolicy: Actual localized Debug app UI and synthetic documents, in an independent UI-test library. Four locales include Traditional Chinese. No UI pixels redrawn. Final-release UI changes require affected scenes to be recaptured.
